scripts.ingest:all: pnpm ingest -- --strategy=fixed && pnpm ingest -- --strategy=recursive && pnpm ingest -- --strategy=sliding
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml logs -f api web
